lines.text: The governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, put a scarlet robe on Him, and set a crown of thorns on His head.
The soldiers spit on Jesus and struck Him on the head, then forced Simon from Cyrene to carry His cross.
At a place called Golgotha, they offered Jesus wine mixed with gall, but after tasting it He refused to drink.
After crucifying Jesus, the soldiers cast lots for His garments, and two robbers were crucified with Him, one on each side.
Passersby told Jesus to come down from the cross, and the chief priests, scribes, and elders said they would believe in Him.
